kypExtensions.summary: The three-stage grammar of the printed rail: every study passes Recruiting participants → Performing study → Interpreting results, and each bias enters at the stage whose work it distorts — the recruiting band holds ONE trap (selection, with its three printed faces: convenience, Berkson 'bedside', attrition), the performing band holds FOUR (recall, measurement, procedure, observer-expectancy — what is remembered, measured, done, expected), the interpreting band holds TWO (lead-time, length-time — how screening results are read); the 1-4-2 census and the 'stage → distorted action → trap → fix' decode are the KYP synthesis of the printed bands.
kypExtensions.rationale: The source prints the three band labels as group headers but never states the generating grammar (the stage where the distortion enters names the trap) nor the 1-4-2 census; the synthesis is KYP's.
kypExtensions.location: core.keyIdea MOVES 1-2 + mechanisms[0] stage-trap-map + blocks[3] the steps block + the registry visual's left rail and rule strip

kypExtensions.summary: The fix-toolbox reading of the STRATEGIES column: six printed fix families mapped stage-to-trap — randomization (similar distributions of known and unknown variables) + the right comparison/reference group → selection; a shorter exposure-to-follow-up window + medical records → recall; objective, standardized, previously tested methods planned ahead of time + a placebo group → measurement; the ONE merged cell (blinding (masking) + placebo, neither participants nor researchers aware of assignments) → procedure AND observer-expectancy together; back-end survival adjusted for severity at diagnosis (caveat: potential masking of causality) → lead-time; the screening RCT (screening program vs no screening) → length-time; the claim 'fixes are stage-matched' and the read-a-named-fix-backwards move are KYP's.
kypExtensions.rationale: The source prints the strategies per row; the toolbox organization, the stage-matching rule, and the reverse-reading move are KYP's design.
kypExtensions.location: mechanisms[1] fix-toolbox-map + core.keyIdea MOVE 4 + blocks[2] the decoder list + the registry visual's fix chips and merged fix box

kypExtensions.summary: The pattern/trap/pivot/mini-case attack structure layered over the printed page — 4 patterns (the mammography lead-time stem, the slowly-progressive-cancer length-time stem, the solvent-recall case-control stem, the wearable-monitor Hawthorne stem), 4 traps (lead-time vs length-time; Hawthorne vs observer-expectancy — whose awareness acts; procedure vs observer-expectancy — unequal care vs expectant documentation, both killed by the merged cell; Berkson vs attrition — the two enrollment-vs-retention faces of selection), 3 pivots (the screening-bias router, the bias-vs-confounding boundary with the next page, the named-fix read backwards), and 9 recall cards covering all seven rows plus the rail and the randomization fix.
kypExtensions.rationale: First Aid prints the definitions, examples, and strategies only; the attack structure, distractor shapes, and question templates are KYP's design.
